response.text: {"title": "Risks and assumptions", "text": "The main risks include the final document exceeding 15 pages or being sent after 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12 due to network blockages, which would lead to rejection without evaluation [RSK-001]. To respond, we would enforce a strict 12-page limit on the draft document and send a test e-mail with the attachment size to the Trust's office one day prior [RSK-001]. A further risk is cloud infrastructure or third-party backup services storing personal data outside the United Kingdom during migration, causing a breach of mandatory data residency requirements leading to contract termination [RSK-002]. We would audit all cloud resource region settings before deploying work package 1.1 and obtain written confirmation of data center locations from the hosting provider [RSK-002]. Additionally, delays in historic data migration could push the staff training schedule past the 2027-06-30 deadline, violating the go-live readiness mandate [RSK-003]. We would run staff training in parallel with the final stages of historic migration using synthetic test data and de-scope non-essential historic records for day-one migration [RSK-003]. It remains an open question what specific format is required for the e-mail submission under REQ-0001 to prevent rejection by the Trust's mail server [Q-01].", "cited_ids": ["RSK-001", "RSK-002", "RSK-003", "Q-01"]}
